purpose: Approved visual metadata for Coachi TikTok, Instagram, and Pinterest slideshow production.

library_scale_target.next_step: Expand only after the first slideshow workflow is repeatable and assets pass rights review.

allowed: Pinterest-inspired style notes without copying the image
blocked: creator-owned images copied directly from social platforms
images with baked-in text unless intentionally marked as final

hybrid_cost_model.name: one_ai_hook_six_library_assets

naive_model.description: Comparison-only baseline. Do not use this as the Coachi production path.

hybrid_model.description: Generate only the hook image, use tagged Supabase visual-library assets for payoff and CTA slides, then composite text locally.

slide_source_rules.reason: custom scene must match the topic exactly
approved marketing-library visuals in Supabase plus local text overlay are cheaper and operationally cleaner
ending slide can reuse a clean CTA/comment/save background from the Supabase library

caveats: crop and color grade locally for a consistent Coachi palette
tag by mood, role, context, route, and platform

blocked_patterns: do not generate all slideshow images with Images 2.0
do not use Images 2.0 for slides 2-7 in the default pipeline
do not bake slide text into generated images

identities.description: Photorealistic athletic male runner, lean muscular endurance-athlete build, tan complexion, short dark slightly textured hair, realistic sweat, serious calm focused expression, same face family across posts, stronger 2026-04-26 watch-stole-the-run viral face style, rotating realistic runner kit.
continuity_rules: same face family across daily running visuals
same tan complexion, short dark textured hair, lean muscular endurance build, and stronger cinematic face detail
rotate pre-workout, during-workout, and post-workout moments across posts
rotate top, headwear, eyewear, shorts, route, weather, lighting, and camera angle
watches are disabled by default; watch-anxiety hooks may include one small unbranded sports watch, but never readable UI, close-ups, or watch-checking poses
avoid static hands-on-hips hero posing unless the topic specifically needs it
avoid distorted hands, knees, ankles, watch-checking poses, readable watch UI, or watch close-ups
prefer the 2026-04-26 watch-stole-the-run face/style direction over the too-clean park-portrait look for slideshow hook images
identities.prompt_anchor: photorealistic athletic male runner, age 25-35, lean muscular endurance-athlete build, masculine, tan complexion, short dark slightly textured hair, same face family across posts, realistic sweat on face and shirt, serious calm focused expression, stronger 2026-04-26 watch-stole-the-run viral face style, fitted black or dark performance kit, real outdoor running moment in one selected route world, premium fitness-editorial aesthetic

phase_variants: pre-workout preparation with light warmup movement and route visible
during-workout steady controlled running effort with natural stride
post-workout cooldown or just-finished moment with sweat and calm satisfaction
phase_constraints: no watch-checking unless concept specifically needs it
no stutter step or unnatural turn during running

safe_angles: wider side angle with route depth
distant front angle only when face quality is strong

route_tags.description: Riverside path, early morning light, natural city/nature background.
route_tags.prompt_fragment: riverside running path, early morning light, realistic city nature background, no blur, no fake cinematic haze

route_tags.description: Mild hill or rolling road where pace naturally changes.
route_tags.prompt_fragment: gentle uphill road, natural stride, realistic road gradient, clean sky area for overlay text

route_tags.description: Open path with visible but realistic wind cues.
route_tags.prompt_fragment: open coastal or riverside path, light wind visible through clothing and trees, natural posture, no dramatic storm

route_tags.description: Simple quiet path for calmer reframe and save/comment slides.
route_tags.prompt_fragment: quiet running path at morning light, clean negative space, realistic background, no face required

style_tags.description: Believable creator-style running footage, not polished stock imagery.
Cleaner fitness editorial look for trust-building Instagram and Pinterest assets.

pinterest_research_collections.label: CTA (ending)
selection_notes: make the viewer know what to do next
pinterest_research_collections.prompt_translation: minimal running path or calm finish scene with strong negative space for a final question or save prompt

pinterest_research_collections.label: Lake (calm)
pinterest_research_collections.usage: Calm reframe slides where the post shifts from anxiety to control.
selection_notes: use for lower-tension middle or ending slides
good for effort, recovery, and confidence resets
pinterest_research_collections.prompt_translation: calm lake-side running route, soft natural light, relaxed runner posture, premium but believable fitness image

pinterest_research_collections.label: Details (emotion)
pinterest_research_collections.usage: Emotional detail slides that make the runner problem feel human.
selection_notes: use for tension before the reframe
avoid watch close-ups unless the post is explicitly about watch anxiety
prioritize body language over facial drama
pinterest_research_collections.prompt_translation: realistic close detail from a run, controlled breathing, hands relaxed, natural emotion, no distorted limbs or fake sweat

pinterest_research_collections.label: Nature (context)
pinterest_research_collections.usage: Context slides that show route, terrain, weather, fatigue, or environment.
selection_notes: use when the point is that the environment changes the number
keep backgrounds visible, not blurred out
make the context obvious at thumbnail size
pinterest_research_collections.prompt_translation: realistic nature running route with visible terrain context, natural light, full background detail, clean overlay area

pinterest_research_collections.label: Hills (effort)
pinterest_research_collections.usage: Effort and pace-context slides where the runner needs to understand why numbers change.
selection_notes: use for pace-is-lying and effort-over-split ideas
show a real gradient, not a dramatic mountain
pinterest_research_collections.prompt_translation: same runner on a gentle uphill route, natural stride, realistic gradient, controlled effort, clean sky or path area for overlay text

pinterest_expansion_backlog.label: Watch / GPS gear context
pinterest_expansion_backlog.why_missing: Current watch searches skew toward wrist close-ups and treadmill/device shots. Coachi needs natural Apple Watch/Garmin context where the watch is visible but not the subject.
pinterest_search_queries: garmin running watch trail runner aesthetic
runner smartwatch wrist natural running aesthetic
accept_if: watch is visible as normal runner kit
outdoor route or workout context is clear

pinterest_expansion_backlog.label: Pre-workout prep
pinterest_expansion_backlog.why_missing: The current library has route/context and calm endings, but not enough before-the-run setup images for warmup, shoes, route choice, and getting-ready slides.
accept_if: feels like a real runner before a session
route or workout context is visible

pinterest_expansion_backlog.label: During-run steady effort
pinterest_expansion_backlog.why_missing: The pipeline needs more natural mid-run movement so slideshows do not rely on static landscapes or post-run poses.

pinterest_expansion_backlog.label: Post-workout sweat / cooldown
pinterest_expansion_backlog.why_missing: The current details folder has only 7 assets. TikTok/Instagram hooks need more real sweat, fatigue, cooldown, and satisfied-but-grounded runner emotion.
pinterest_search_queries: male runner post run sweat outdoor aesthetic

pinterest_expansion_backlog.label: Headwear / sunglasses / kit variation
pinterest_expansion_backlog.why_missing: Avatar variation now rotates cap, headband, glasses, and shorts color. The visual library should support that same variety for non-hook slides.
pinterest_search_queries: running cap sunglasses trail runner aesthetic
accept_if: kit feels like real running gear
face can be partially visible or obscured naturally

pinterest_expansion_backlog.label: Road / weather context
pinterest_expansion_backlog.why_missing: Current context assets skew nature/trail. Coachi needs road, wind, heat, rain, and everyday-route context for Apple Watch and pace/effort posts.
accept_if: weather context is obvious but not extreme

text_overlay_defaults.placement_rule: Keep overlays in the center or lower-middle safe zone; treat legacy bottom as lower_middle to avoid TikTok and Instagram UI overlap.
